units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 40b:3">B. Mets. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>טרחיה ודמי בַרְזָנִיתֵיה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בַּרזַנְיָיתָא</he> pl.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) his (the seller’s) trouble and the value of his tapping (the sample; v. <cite ref="B01224"><he>בַּרְזִינָא</he></cite>). [Var. in Rashi <he>כוז׳</he> his calling out, offering for sale, v. <cite ref="K01136"><he>כְּרַז</he></cite>.]
